# The Vault Autohaus

> Car paint protection and detailing studio in South Africa: clear, matte and colour paint protection film (PPF), fitting of wings and other exterior parts, exterior and interior detailing, polishing and ceramic coating.

## Prices (South African rand)
- Frontal PPF: R15 000, with a complimentary detail
- Full PPF: R35 000, with a complimentary detail
- Colour PPF: R40 000, with a complimentary detail (394 TPU colour films to choose from)
- Detail without a wrap: R4 000 to R6 000
